items.t: Goldman Sachs Maintains Neutral on Etoro Group, Lowers Price Target to $22
items.sum: Goldman Sachs analyst James Yaro maintains Etoro Group (NASDAQ:ETOR) with a Neutral and lowers the price target from $25 to $22.

items.t: Showdown between Alberta and TC Energy
items.sum: Alberta’s Bill 45 could let the province plan, finance and build natural gas pipelines. TC Energy warns government intervention could jeopardize its proposed expansion.

items.t: $72B in Ether sits exposed to quantum attack
items.sum: Researchers found that about 42 million ether, worth roughly $72 billion, sits in wallets whose public keys are already exposed to a future quantum computer. Their fix could take months to roll out, and no major exchange they reviewed had a compatible backup. CoinDesk's Uyen Truong hosts "CoinDesk Daily."

items.t: NYSE Parent's Tokenized Stock Venture Opens With 113 Assets Planned. Apple, Nvidia And Tesla Are Staying Out.
items.sum: OKX and NYSE parent ICE are launching a 24/7 tokenized securities venue with 113 assets planned for a phased rollout. Apple, Nvidia, Tesla and other major companies have objected to participation.

items.t: OKX and NYSE Parent ICE Launch Tokenized Stock Venue With 113 Assets Lined Up
items.sum: The venue is set to go live at 12 p.m. ET Monday with only six stocks, including Coinbase and Circle, on its Nov. 20 launch list, while 67 companies, Apple and Nvidia among them, have objected to their shares trading there.
